item.title: Anthony Edwards, Timberwolves outlast short-handed Clippers 94-88
item.description: INGLEWOOD, Calif. (AP) — Anthony Edwards scored 31 points, Donte DiVincenzo added 18 and the surging Minnesota Timberwolves beat Los Angeles Clippers 94-88 on Thursday night.

item.title: Nazem Kadri scores 2 goals to lead the Flames to a 4-1 win over the Sharks
item.description: SAN JOSE, Calif. (AP) — Nazem Kadri scored two goals and the Calgary Flames beat the San Jose Sharks 4-1 on Thursday night in the first game back from the Olympic break for both teams.

item.title: Maxey breaks Iverson’s 76ers 3-point record in 124-117 win over Heat
item.description: PHILADELPHIA (AP) — Tyrese Maxey broke Allen Iverson’s 76ers franchise record for 3-pointers, finishing with five 3s and 28 points Thursday night in Philadelphia’s 124-117 victory over the Miami Heat.

item.title: Brad Marchand scores twice as the Panthers beat the Maple Leafs 5-1
US military used laser to take down Border Protection drone, lawmakers say
item.description: The U.S. military used a laser Thursday to shoot down a “seemingly threatening” drone flying near the U.S.-Mexico border. It turned out the drone belonged to Customs and Border Protection, lawmakers said.
